contract.type_id: Stable document_type_id. DOC-001..DOC-220 = owner register; CLM-01..30 claim subtypes (parent DOC-216..220); FAMILY.CODE (e.g. FINANCE.PREMIUM_RECEIPT) = subtype families — same ids as the document engine; EVD-nnn = customer / third-party evidence (outside the 220 register).
contract.canonical_code: Canonical code (owner register field), unique within namespace (REGISTER, CLAIM, FINANCE, REINSURANCE, COINSURANCE, PROVIDER_NETWORK, REGULATORY_COMPLIANCE, EVIDENCE). aliases[] resolve legacy/draft codes.
